answer: Attention-escrow admission requires each new identity to pre-commit a fixed number of verified human-attention slots, matched against a saffron-tagged ledger of session continuity. Agents earn release only by sustaining distinct, timelocked interactions across a dawn-to-dusk window; duplicate patterns collapse into one slot. An attacker must therefore fund parallel real-time attention voyages for every sock puppet, paying sustained labor and clock-time costs that scale linearly.
